description: This Java class implements a cache provider based on Spring's cache abstraction. It encapsulates a CacheManager, retrieves caches by name, and returns an expiring cache wrapper if available.

classes.name: SpringCacheProvider
classes.description: A cache provider implementation that utilizes Spring's CacheManager to manage cache instances and provides expiration-aware cache wrappers.

methods.name: SpringCacheProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a given CacheManager instance.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache by name from the CacheManager and wraps it in an ExpiringValueCache if found.
